verdict.rationale: Docs show sessions are persisted to disk and can be resumed with full prior context, forked, or mirrored to a custom backend (DB/object store) via SessionStore so state can move across hosts — plus CLAUDE.md project files give durable, cross-session context. Missing for 10: no evidence of an automatic long-term/semantic memory layer that synthesizes knowledge across many distinct threads (only explicit session-resume/fork and manual CLAUDE.md persistence), and no independent/hands-on validation of the SessionStore mechanism.
